root_cause_analysis.incident: Mission reached seq ~5189 while GUI Activity Panel showed 0 events

root_causes.defect: Snapshot polling periodically fetched authoritative snapshots where last_sequence was ~5189, and filtered in-memory events with: currentState.events.filter(e => (e.sequence || 0) > incomingSnapshot.last_sequence). This completely erased all events with sequence <= 5189, resulting in 0 events rendered in the GUI.
root_causes.remediation: Preserved historical event timeline across snapshot refreshes by merging incoming snapshots with local event journal while deduplicating by sequence and event_id.

root_causes.defect: Missing EvidenceKind import in serializer.py resulted in NameError during restore_persisted_missions snapshot deserialization on server startup.
Events were dispatched to in-memory history and active subscribers before SQLite transaction commitment was guaranteed, risking broadcast of phantom events if disk writes failed.
root_causes.remediation: Enforced strict durability-before-broadcast order: validate -> assign monotonic sequence -> synchronously commit to SQLite database -> append to history -> dispatch to live subscribers.

root_causes.defect: Missing os import in runtime_adapter.py caused NameError when accessing os.getpid() during mission resumption.
root_causes.remediation: Imported os at module top level.

prompt_composer.auto_expansion: Textarea expands smoothly up to 220px maxHeight, then scrolls internally

activity_panel.status: Truthful waiting states rendered; no fake timers or progress bars
activity_panel.timeline: Monotonically ordered sequence, timestamps, status colors, and readable payload details
